# bko-holt load plan for layout.json
# Source: tumbleweed, openSUSE Tumbleweed, BIOS boot with grub, dumped 2026-11-08T02:19:01Z
#
# Disks:
#   vda (16 GiB) -> /dev/sdq

# ---- partition ----
# vda -> /dev/sdq: clear the old table and signatures
wipefs --all /dev/sdq
# /dev/sdq: its first 4 MiB zeroed, and its last 1 MiB (a GPT's backup, md 0.90/1.0 superblocks, ZFS's end labels)
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=1M count=4 conv=fsync
sh -c 'n=$(blockdev --getsz /dev/sdq) && dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=$((n - 2048)) count=2048 conv=fsync'
# the new partitions' old content zeroed through /dev/sdq, before its table names them (blocks of 512 bytes, at their start= sectors)
# vda1: its first 4 MiB and its last 1 MiB
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=2048 count=8192 conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=2097152 count=2048 conv=fsync
# vda2: its first 4 MiB and its last 1 MiB
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=2099200 count=8192 conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=6291456 count=2048 conv=fsync
# vda3: its first 4 MiB and its last 1 MiB
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=6293504 count=8192 conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=33552384 count=2048 conv=fsync
# udev done with /dev/sdq before sfdisk takes it
udevadm settle
sfdisk --wipe always --wipe-partitions always /dev/sdq <<'EOF'
label: dos
label-id: 0xbc000001
unit: sectors
sector-size: 512

/dev/sdq1 : start=2048, size=2097152, type=83, bootable
/dev/sdq2 : start=2099200, size=4194304, type=82
/dev/sdq3 : start=6293504, size=27260928, type=83
EOF
udevadm settle

# ---- assemble ----
# (nothing to do)

# ---- format ----
# vda1: ext4
mke2fs -F -q -t ext4 -O none,has_journal,ext_attr,resize_inode,dir_index,orphan_file,filetype,extent,64bit,flex_bg,metadata_csum_seed,sparse_super,large_file,huge_file,dir_nlink,extra_isize,metadata_csum -U bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001 -b 4096 -I 256 -N 65536 -g 32768 -G 16 -E hash_seed=bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002,desc_size=64,resize=268435456 /dev/sdq1 1048576k
tune2fs -r 13107 /dev/sdq1
# check: /dev/sdq1 is ext4 with the source's features (read back by bko-holt's own probe)
# vda2: swap
mkswap -U bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003 --pagesize 4096 /dev/sdq2
# check: /dev/sdq2 is swap with the source's UUID, label and page size (read back by bko-holt's own probe)
# vda3: btrfs
mkfs.btrfs -f -O extref,skinny-metadata,no-holes,^raid56,^raid1c34,^zoned,^squota,free-space-tree,block-group-tree -U bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004 --csum crc32c -n 16384 -s 4096 -d single -m dup --device-uuid bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005 /dev/sdq3
# check: /dev/sdq3 is btrfs with the source's features (read back by bko-holt's own probe)
mkdir -p /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004
# btrfs bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004: its subvolumes
mount -t btrfs -o subvolid=5 /dev/sdq3 /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004
btrfs subvolume create /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004/@
mkdir -p /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004/@
btrfs subvolume create /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004/@/var
mkdir -p /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004/@/usr
btrfs subvolume create /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004/@/usr/local
mkdir -p /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004/@
btrfs subvolume create /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004/@/srv
mkdir -p /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004/@
btrfs subvolume create /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004/@/root
mkdir -p /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004/@
btrfs subvolume create /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004/@/opt
mkdir -p /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004/@
btrfs subvolume create /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004/@/home
mkdir -p /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004/@
btrfs subvolume create /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004/@/.snapshots
mkdir -p /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004/@/.snapshots/1
btrfs subvolume create /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004/@/.snapshots/1/snapshot
btrfs subvolume set-default /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004/@/.snapshots/1/snapshot
umount /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004

# ---- mount ----
mkdir -p /mnt/bko-target
mount -t btrfs -o defaults /dev/sdq3 /mnt/bko-target
mkdir -p /mnt/bko-target/.snapshots
mount -t btrfs -o subvol=/@/.snapshots /dev/sdq3 /mnt/bko-target/.snapshots
mkdir -p /mnt/bko-target/boot
mount -t ext4 -o data=ordered /dev/sdq1 /mnt/bko-target/boot
mkdir -p /mnt/bko-target/home
mount -t btrfs -o subvol=/@/home /dev/sdq3 /mnt/bko-target/home
mkdir -p /mnt/bko-target/opt
mount -t btrfs -o subvol=/@/opt /dev/sdq3 /mnt/bko-target/opt
mkdir -p /mnt/bko-target/root
mount -t btrfs -o subvol=/@/root /dev/sdq3 /mnt/bko-target/root
mkdir -p /mnt/bko-target/srv
mount -t btrfs -o subvol=/@/srv /dev/sdq3 /mnt/bko-target/srv
mkdir -p /mnt/bko-target/var
mount -t btrfs -o subvol=/@/var /dev/sdq3 /mnt/bko-target/var
mkdir -p /mnt/bko-target/usr/local
mount -t btrfs -o subvol=/@/usr/local /dev/sdq3 /mnt/bko-target/usr/local

# ---- restore ----
mkdir -p -m 700 /run/bko-holt
# the archiver's restore --exact and --target-metadata, for the btrfs snapshots and aliases
sh -c 'rustic-bko restore --help > /run/bko-holt/restore.help 2>&1; grep -q -- '\''--exact'\'' /run/bko-holt/restore.help && grep -q -- '\''--target-metadata'\'' /run/bko-holt/restore.help || { echo "rustic-bko has no restore --exact and --target-metadata, which this layout'\''s btrfs needs: use rustic-bko 0.11.4+backotter.11 or newer" >&2; exit 1; }'
# left out of the restore: btrfs subvolumes mounted elsewhere, seen again (aliases), and the contents of the shared snapshots, made after it
cat > /run/bko-holt/restore.globs <<'EOF'
!/.snapshots/1/snapshot/**
!/.snapshots/2/snapshot/**
EOF
# snapshot latest of /srv/bko-repo, with BackOtter's restore flags
RUSTIC_STRICT_EXIT=true rustic-bko --repository /srv/bko-repo --no-progress restore --numeric-id --target-metadata --glob-file /run/bko-holt/restore.globs latest /mnt/bko-target
mkdir -p /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004
# btrfs bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004: its shared snapshots (noatime: reading them changes nothing)
mount -t btrfs -o subvolid=5,noatime /dev/sdq3 /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004
# @/.snapshots/2/snapshot: a snapshot of @/.snapshots/1/snapshot, then made exact from the backup's /.snapshots/2/snapshot (ID 265, as on the source)
sh -c 'd=/run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004/@/.snapshots/2/snapshot; p=/run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004/@/.snapshots/2; mkdir -p "$p" && touch -r "$p" /run/bko-holt/times.ref || exit; if [ -d "$d" ] && [ "$(stat -c %i "$d")" != 256 ] && [ -z "$(ls -A "$d")" ]; then rmdir "$d" && btrfs subvolume snapshot /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004/@/.snapshots/1/snapshot "$d" && RUSTIC_STRICT_EXIT=true rustic-bko --repository /srv/bko-repo --no-progress restore --numeric-id --exact --clone-from /=/run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004/@/.snapshots/1/snapshot latest:/.snapshots/2/snapshot /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004/@/.snapshots/2/snapshot; else btrfs subvolume create "$d" && echo "@/.snapshots/2/snapshot: not in the backup; made empty"; fi || exit; touch -r /run/bko-holt/times.ref "$p" || exit; id=$(btrfs inspect-internal rootid "$d") && [ "$id" = 265 ] || echo "@/.snapshots/2/snapshot: ID $id here, 265 in the plan"'
btrfs property set -ts /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004/@/.snapshots/2/snapshot ro true
btrfs quota enable /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004
btrfs quota rescan -w /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004
btrfs qgroup create 1/0 /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004
btrfs qgroup assign --no-rescan 0/265 1/0 /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004
btrfs quota rescan -w /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004
umount /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004
# the atimes the restore set, for boot to put back after its reads
sh -c 'mkdir -p -m 700 /run/bko-holt && find /mnt/bko-target \( -path /mnt/bko-target/dev -o -path /mnt/bko-target/proc -o -path /mnt/bko-target/sys -o -path /mnt/bko-target/run -o -path /mnt/bko-target/.snapshots/2/snapshot \) -prune -o -printf '\''%A@\t%p\0'\'' | LC_ALL=C sort -z > /run/bko-holt/atimes.before'

# ---- boot ----
# refuses to start unless /mnt/bko-target/etc/fstab is the restored system's (its / matches the layout's)

mount -o remount,atime,relatime /mnt/bko-target
# the restored atimes (the restore stage lists them), to put back after this stage's reads
sh -c '[ -s /run/bko-holt/atimes.before ] || { mkdir -p -m 700 /run/bko-holt && find /mnt/bko-target \( -path /mnt/bko-target/dev -o -path /mnt/bko-target/proc -o -path /mnt/bko-target/sys -o -path /mnt/bko-target/run -o -path /mnt/bko-target/.snapshots/2/snapshot \) -prune -o -printf '\''%A@\t%p\0'\'' | LC_ALL=C sort -z > /run/bko-holt/atimes.before; }'

sh -c 'rm -rf /run/bko-holt/lvm-devices; [ ! -d /mnt/bko-target/etc/lvm/devices ] || { cp -a /mnt/bko-target/etc/lvm/devices /run/bko-holt/lvm-devices && touch -r /mnt/bko-target/etc/lvm /run/bko-holt/lvm-devices.parent; }'
